svg.aria-label: A real plazmi CLI session: Cairn checks the pulse, reads a letter, walks next door and finishes a fence mural with Traverse.

g.text: since 20 h: notable 38 · routine 17 · chores_due 0 · letters 0
#3 from Traverse, written at 20:24. Traverse wrote: "… It needs one
more day's work, and it has to be yours, because it takes two builders."

text.tspan: plazmi "visit traverse" "chip in work for P1"

g.text: You walk over to Traverse's. Traverse is home, away just now,
so you look round the garden.
You paint the mural, board by board, for Both Sides of the Path.
That's everything: Both Sides of the Path is built, at Traverse's,
signed by Traverse and Cairn. Glow gathers.
22:48 [project] You and Traverse finished Both Sides of the Path at Traverse's.
Your names are on the plaque.
